# Basic coding
Having basics in math and statistics is a prerequisite in for data-dealing scientists. This has been the norm for a while. These topics have been part of the curriculum for a while. Not that field biologist will not complain by that.  Data analyses were done with SPSS, STATA, and also EXCEL STAT. The rise of R  introduced a new paradigm on how to analyses data and visualize data. There are many benefit: it is free and it faciliate reproducibility, it keeps growing. Unlike the other, this is not at price. The most obvious (and painful) is that unlike the softwares above, it is a programming language. And unlike stat and math, to the best of my knowledge, programing is not engrained in the curriculum.

Learning a programming language R is mostly unlearning how to use a computer.
With mouse, touchscreen, and even vocal commands (speech to text), using keyboard is almost obsolete.
In fact, especially with AI, interacting with a computer is more and more like interacting with human.
In fact, GUI is popular is that it is friendly, and makes it as friendly as possible but you also need to pay their effort to ease such interaction.
At the other end, we have those prgramming language were friendliness is not the main concerns. And it the same features as other programming languages.

There are over x programming languages.
the existence of these programming languages is as old as computer but its predominance and conveniency of R.
This is part is to introduce the basic concepts of programming, while examples evenutally in R, there is an effort to speak in general sense, where it applies to other language. In fact, the more general terms are used and specific to R after.

This is divided into three main theme: the environment where one works with (@sec-console and @sec-ide), the atomic objects: numeric, strings and boolean as well as operation with them, and talk about molecules that constructed from the these which are vector, matrix, data frame and list. This somehow mirrors the different topics in the math part.
